http_401: Session expired or invalid credentials. Please sign in again.
http_403: You do not have sufficient permissions to perform this action.
http_404: The requested resource was not found.
http_409: Conflict with entered data (e.g. duplicate barcode or email).
http_422: Sent data contains validation or format errors.
http_500: Internal server error. Technical support has been notified.
network_error: Connection error with server. Please check your internet connection.
user_not_found: User or email address not found.
company_exists: A company is already registered with this corporate email.
product_not_found: Specified product does not exist in database.
out_of_stock: Product does not have sufficient stock to complete operation.
cash_register_closed: Cash register is currently closed. You must open a shift to checkout.
cash_register_already_open: Cash register is already open for this user.
